=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:194-224,399,586-592 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A topic is due only with no open session, but approved and failed sessions stay open (only reject closes), and the gate has no resume outcome, so resume and outcome review (Goals 2 and 9) can never run.
  WHY: The topic is blocked permanently after one approval and interrupted sessions are never re-entered; severity disagreement: sonnet MAJOR, minimax BLOCKER (highest used).
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:476-480,505-514,577-600,735 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan says phases 1-3 can merge in any order, but Phase 2 calls the engine and scripts Phase 1 creates, and Phase 3 edits files Phase 2 creates.
  WHY: Merging out of order leaves workflows calling absent scripts and the smoke tests cannot pass.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:577-584,606-611 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The brainstorm.yml workflow_call secrets list omits AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET, which the consumer template forwards.
  WHY: GitHub rejects a caller passing an undeclared secret, so every consumer wrapper fails; severity disagreement: MAJOR vs BLOCKER (highest used).
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:418-429 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Outcome processing reads the 3 oldest approved sessions each run with no checked marker or rotation, so stuck old sessions starve newer ones.
  WHY: Newer outcome-eligible sessions never get an outcome review.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:162-170,416-429 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The issues list (per_page=100) and timeline reads are unpaginated for open-session detection, ledger and outcome discovery.
  WHY: Sessions beyond page 1 are invisible, which causes duplicate sessions and missed outcomes; severity disagreement: sonnet NIT for the issues call, others MAJOR (highest used).
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:418-429 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The single unpaginated timeline read (30-event default) stops before the cross-referenced event, so tracking=<N> is never found.
  WHY: No session becomes outcome-eligible and Goal 9 never fires.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:416-429 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not require the orchestrator to post tracking_comment on its new tracking issue, so no cross-referenced event may land on the session issue.
  WHY: tracking discovery returns nothing and outcomes stay ineligible.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:89-93,465,503-514,738 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Phase 2 smoke run expects an opened session, but the gate exits outcome=disabled when BRAINSTORM_ENABLED is unset, and no bypass (the force input) is defined.
  WHY: The Done criterion cannot pass without an undocumented variable or bypass.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:268-277,444-447 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The secret scan skips BRAINSTORM_DATA_SECRETS values shorter than 6 characters and the plan sets no minimum length.
  WHY: Short credentials can reach snapshots, prompts or comments unredacted; severity disagreement: NIT (glm) vs MAJOR (highest used); sonnet raised it only as a hardening suggestion.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:343-355,596-600,609-610 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Turn trust requires the issue-opening bot login, but the plan does not say turns are posted with github.token, and GH_PAT comments appear as the owner.
  WHY: Every turn is rejected as untrusted_turn and resume fails; severity disagreement: glm NIT (highest used).
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:409-414 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Free-text idea, expected and outcome values sit unencoded in a space-delimited HTML-comment marker.
  WHY: A `-->`, newline or `=` truncates or spoofs the ledger fields.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:152-161,636-644 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The §26 bullet gives job counts only for the schedule event, not for the new issue_comment trigger, and does not justify not folding it into an existing comment wrapper.
  WHY: Each consumer gets a skipped run per comment, which §26 treats as a review-blocker; severity disagreement: glm NIT (highest used).
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:287,534 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The "(D3)" citations point to the CLI-engine plan's D3 but collide with this document's own D3 (Persistence and ledger) at line 764.
  WHY: Readers land on the wrong decision.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:(check-runs lint and static-checks) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Both check-runs stopped at the merge-ref freshness guard with outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed (pr=9239).
  WHY: The guard fails until the branch is updated from main; it is not a defect in the plan.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Goal 9: the next session for that topic first posts an outcome review comparing expected and measured impact
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md Hand-off (384-399), Due rule (220-224), gate outcomes (590-592)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Approve leaves the session issue open, so the no-open-session rule blocks every future session; the gate has no resume outcome; the orchestrator-side cross-reference dependency is unstated.
- requirement: Phase 2 Done: a dispatched smoke run with a fixture brief and stub seats opens a session issue, posts turns, opens a plan PR (gate exits outcome=disabled when BRAINSTORM_ENABLED is unset)
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md Phase 2 step 1/2 (577-592) or the Automation summary
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk names the mechanism by which internal-brainstorm.yml bypasses the disabled guard, nor an env-var bypass on brainstorm_gate.py.
- requirement: Reusable workflow must declare every secret the template forwards (Phase 2 step 1 lines 577-584 vs step 7 lines 606-611)
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md Phase 2 step 1 secrets list
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Step 1 lists only GH_PAT, TG_BOT_SECRET, BRAINSTORM_DATA_SECRETS, while step 7 also forwards AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:220-224,194,201-202,586-590,95-96 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A topic is due only with no open session and the session job exits already_open, but only reject closes a session issue, so the resume path and Goal 9 outcome review are unreachable.
  WHY: Approved, failed and budget-cut sessions stay open and block the topic.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:478,735 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Phases 2 and 3 modify files created by earlier phases, so "any order" merge is false.
  WHY: Phase 3 cannot apply before Phase 2, and Phase 2 needs the Phase 1 engine.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:578,610 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow_call secrets list omits AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET, which the template forwards.
  WHY: GitHub rejects the call on every consumer.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:418-429 | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: One unpaginated timeline read per session (default 30 events) misses the late cross-referenced event.
  WHY: tracking=<N> is never found, so Goal 9 never fires.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:418-421 | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 3 oldest approved sessions are re-read every run with no checked marker or rotation.
  WHY: Abandoned or open projects starve newer sessions.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:162-166,586-590 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: One per_page=100 issues call without pagination serves open-session detection, the ledger and outcome candidates.
  WHY: Long-lived approved sessions drop off page 1.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:411 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Marker free-text values (idea, expected, outcome) are unencoded.
  WHY: Spaces, `-->` or embedded markers can corrupt or spoof ledger and state fields.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:507-513,89-91,467,758-759 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The smoke run expects an opened session while the gate exits disabled when BRAINSTORM_ENABLED is unset, and the force input and fixture brief handling are undefined.
  WHY: The smoke test cannot pass without an invented bypass.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:(check-runs lint and static-checks) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both check-runs stopped at the merge-ref freshness guard (outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed, pr=9239).
  WHY: The guard exits 1 until the branch is updated from main; no plan edit resolves it.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:287,534,764 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "(D3)" citations point at the CLI-engine plan's D3 but collide with this plan's own D3.
  WHY: Readers land on the wrong decision.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:152-160,636-644 | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The §26 bullet gives job counts only for the schedule event, not the new issue_comment wrapper trigger.
  WHY: Each consumer gets an extra skipped run per comment, which §26 treats as a review-blocker.
- (hardening) docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:411 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=2
  PROBLEM: Encode idea, expected and outcome (base64url or JSON) and accept only the first marker.
  WHY: Prevents marker corruption.
- (hardening) docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:268-276 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=2
  PROBLEM: Secret values shorter than 6 characters and non-string values are never matched; warn or fail closed.
  WHY: Closes the short-secret gap.
